script_text: A cosmic storm is brewing in your chart that Aquarius cannot afford to sleep through. Early week Monday through Wednesday, your ruling planet Uranus in the 3rd House squares Mercury in your 12th House, scrambling communication and causing Tuesday to feel mentally foggy while Wednesday brings relief as the Sun in your 7th House trines Saturn in the 11th, stabilizing a love commitment. Midweek the turning point hits Thursday when Venus enters your 5th House, igniting romance and creative spark after the heavy early friction. Late week Thursday through Sunday, Mars in your 10th House sextiles Pluto in the 8th on Saturday, driving a career power move and possible bonus money while Sunday soothes with lunar calm in your 4th. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trine Saturn clarifies love; Tuesday is your worst day because Uranus square Mercury distorts your air-element logic. Talk to your boss Friday about the raise Mars supports. Follow for daily updates.
